items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jack Capp and Dave Capp organizing Decca/Capp records. The interviewee confirms knowledge of Dave Capp ('Dave Capp.') and later mentions his own name was on a recording, but there is no direct evidence of a personal relationship, collaboration, or meeting between Narvin Kimb

ctx.x: But this is what had been done. It was recorded by the Inc Spots on Decca Record number 1731.
The Caps later organized Decca, you know. Yeah. They started out in Brunswick, I guess. Jack Capp and Dave Capp.
